name: Juan Fernando López Aguilar - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the amendment of the European Electoral act, allowing Members to vote in plenary by proxy voting during pregnancy and after giving birth
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to change the rules so that a Member who is pregnant or has just given birth can have another Member vote for her in the full Parliament. Under current rules, every Member must vote in person. The change would cover up to three months before the expected birth and up to six months after. Parliament has adopted this proposal and sent it to the Council.

- Members who are pregnant or have given birth may have another Member vote for them in the full Parliament.
- It affects Members of the European Parliament; the Council must approve the change, and all Member States must agree.
- The new rule starts only after every Member State has completed its own approval process.
